    The covering construction as a controlled embedding #

    Alternative (2) of Theorem 3.14 in data form. A Galois covering R → A with torsion-free group G enters only through the finite full subquiver D of the quiver of R on the support Σ = supp L(S₊) ∪ supp L(S₋), the restriction p : D → Q of the covering map, and the action of G on the objects of R (CoverData): G acts freely, it is torsion-free, and two arrows of D with the same label are G-translates of each other. Grouping block positions (γ x, x) by γ ∈ G gives the classes of Proposition 4.5 (CoverData.blockClasses); a class γ ≠ 1 misses a column because γ Σ ≠ Σ.

    CoveringData k A adds an exact fully faithful functor L from Kronecker modules of any dimension to representations of D, with every vertex of D in the support of L(S₊) or L(S₋), and a presentation kQ → A whose kernel acts by zero on p_*L(T). By the facts about S₋ (RepresentationEmbeddings/CoveringConstruction/SimpleInjectiveFacts.lean) it gives the data of Theorem 5.2.

    structure LargeIndecomposable.Covering.CoverData {D Q : FinQuiver} (p : D.Hom Q) :
    Type 1

    The finite part of a Galois covering with torsion-free group: a free action of G on the objects R₀, an embedding ι of the vertices of D, and the condition that equally labelled arrows of D are translates of each other.

    • G : Type

      The group of the covering.

    • group : Group self.G
    • torsionFree (g : self.G) : g ≠ 1 → ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → g ^ n ≠ 1
    • R₀ : Type

      The objects of the covering.

    • act : MulAction self.G self.R₀
    • free (g : self.G) (x : self.R₀) : g • x = x → g = 1
    • ι : D.V → self.R₀

      The vertices of D as objects of the covering.

    • ι_inj : Function.Injective self.ι
    • fibre (x y : D.V) : p.vert x = p.vert y → ∃ (g : self.G), self.ι y = g • self.ι x

      Fibres of p lie in G-orbits.

    • arrows (α β : D.A) : p.arr α = p.arr β → ∃ (g : self.G), self.ι (D.src β) = g • self.ι (D.src α) ∧ self.ι (D.tgt β) = g • self.ι (D.tgt α)
